svg.title: remotion-gpu by Konecz
svg.desc: remotion-gpu, by Konecz. 4.1 times less CPU to export a 75 second production video than Remotion's own <Video> plus NVENC path: 460 s against 112 s of CPU. A paper boat carries frames from the CPU island to the GPU port.
svg.text: less CPU to export the same video
460 s → 112 s of CPU for a 75 s production video,
against Remotion's own GPU path (<Video> + NVENC)
